business_problem: Together, these solutions save the company over 30,000 hours a year in manual processing time.
solution_summary: Cineplex used Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power BI, Power Platform to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. Every year, teams from across the organization are given eight weeks to build automated solutions for real business scenarios with support from the Automation CoE, culminating in a presentation to the executive leadership team. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.

After a competitive review, Cineplex decided to adopt Power Automate more broadly across the company.
